 India won the toss and invited New Zealand to bat first. Fans in India can stream the match on the SonyLIV app and website
 New Zealand vs India 4th T20I live streaming details
 Our Bureau New Delhi 4 min read Last Updated : Oct 30 2026 | 12:06 PM IST Listen to This Article
 India are looking to extend their dominance over New Zealand as the two sides meet in the fourth T20I at Eden Park in Auckland today. Having secured an unassailable 3-0 lead in the five-match series, the visitors have the opportunity to make it four wins in a row, while Mitchell Santner’s side will be desperate to avoid another defeat on home soil.   Indian skipper Shreyas Iyer won the toss for the fourth straight time in the series and once again invited Mitchell Santner-led New Zealand to bat first. The visitors made two changes in their squad with Ishan Kishan and Mayank Yadav replacing Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Bhuvneshwar Kumar, repectively in the playing 11.   Meanwhile, New Zealand also made one change with Nathan Smith coming in for Kyle Jamieson.   Captain's take after toss:   Shreyas Iyer (IND): We're going to bowl. Just following the same pattern. The intent, the positivity was there from ball one. The execution was phenomenal. The wind is following us everywhere, it's getting chillier. It's important to be ruthless. The boys have been given the same message. Everyone is in high spirits. Expecting bounce and seam movement.   Mitchell Santner (NZ): Another fresh start today. It does bounce a bit more here. Looks like another good pitch. If you get a start, you can cash in. We've talked about plans. Batting group, we've done well. Today's going to be tough to catch with the wind. They come really hard at us in the powerplay.   New Zealand vs India 4th T20I playing 11   New Zealand playing 11: Tim Seifert(w), Finn Allen, Daryl Mitchell, Glenn Phillips, Bevon Jacobs, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner(c), Nathan Smith, Adam Milne, Jacob Duffy, Matthew Fisher   India playing 11: Sanju Samson(w), Abhishek Sharma, Ishan Kishan, Shreyas Iyer(c), Tilak Varma, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Naman Dhir, Axar Patel, Mayank Yadav, Arshdeep Singh, Prince Yadav

   New Zealand vs India 4th T20I: Live streaming and broadcast details
 When will the New Zealand vs India 4th T20I match take place?   The fourth T20I match between New Zealand and India will be played on Friday, October 30.   What will be the venue for the New Zealand vs India 4th T20I match on Friday?   Eden Park in Auckland will host the fourth T20I match between New Zealand and India.   What time will the toss for the New Zealand vs India 4th T20I match take place?   The toss for the New Zealand vs India 4th T20I match will take place at 12:00 pm IST.   What time will the New Zealand vs India 4th T20I match begin?   The New Zealand vs India 4th T20I match will begin at 12:30 pm IST.   Where to watch the live telecast of the New Zealand vs India 4th T20I match in India?   The live telecast of the New Zealand vs India 4th T20I will be available on Sony Sports Network in India.   Where to watch the live streaming of the New Zealand vs India 4th T20I match in India?   SonyLIV, through its app and website, will live stream the fourth T20I match between New Zealand and India in India.   More From This Section
